slides.prompt: What does std::move(x) do at runtime?

slides.title: Rule of Five Functions
slides.prompt: Which functions make up C++ Rule of Five?
options: Destructor, Copy Constructor, Copy Assignment, Move Constructor, Move Assignment
Default Constructor, Copy, Move, Virtual, Pure Virtual
slides.correctAnswer: Destructor, Copy Constructor, Copy Assignment, Move Constructor, Move Assignment

slides.title: Lvalue vs Rvalue Definition
slides.prompt: Which statement accurately describes lvalue vs rvalue?
options: Lvalue has identifiable memory location/name; rvalue is temporary value
Lvalue is left of +; rvalue is right of +
Lvalue is integer; rvalue is string
slides.correctAnswer: Lvalue has identifiable memory location/name; rvalue is temporary value

slides.title: Universal / Forwarding Reference Condition
slides.prompt: When does 'T&&' act as a Universal (Forwarding) Reference?
options: When T is a deduced template parameter in function template
Only when const specifier is added
When allocating array with new operator
slides.correctAnswer: When T is a deduced template parameter in function template
